# EcoMug source / EcoMug 来源

- Upstream: https://github.com/dr4kan/EcoMug
- Tag: `v2.1` (commit `9721372`, 2023-07-04)
- Included files: `EcoMug.h`, `LICENSE`
- SHA-256 `EcoMug.h`: `EB796C1BA22BF9F550A10855C2D7CDEA7D6B4256932430201D4DC5D3FAA5C403`
- SHA-256 `LICENSE`: `1B3782CCAD7B8614100CDA30D3FAF42FC39F2E97932908C543005053B654CA68`

EcoMug is GPL-3.0 licensed. Its v2.1 header is vendored so cluster builds do
not need network access. The former `musrSim_upgrade` source and EcoMug version
are unavailable; a new sample must be identified by this repository revision
and generator version, then compared statistically with the historical sample.

## 中文

本仓库固定引入 EcoMug v2.1 的头文件和 GPLv3 许可；集群编译不需要联网。
上面的 SHA-256 可用于核对来源。旧 `musrSim_upgrade` 的源码及其 EcoMug
版本已不可取得，因此新样本须记录本仓库修订版本与生成器版本，并与历史样本
进行统计分布比较，不能声称逐事件复现。
